patch_description: Building on the higher-scoring 3-distinct-parameter variant (single shared RY parameter instead of the two-group split, which reduced param count and improved score from 0.70 to 0.72), this edit merges the RY pre-rotation into one shared parameter `ry_a` across all 8 qubits, and densifies the entangling ring by adding the opposite-qubit, skip-2, and now skip-3 ZZ coupling shells, all reusing the single `zz_ring` parameter. This keeps the trainable parameter count at just 3 distinct names (ry_a, rz_p, zz_ring) while giving the circuit richer long-range entanglement structure, which should help separate the hardest validation group (worst-group margin) without any parameter cost increase, directly following the reasoning that parameter economy always dominates score while structural richness under shared parameters improves separation.
